ideas.title: The Secret Ultrasonic Sound Tracking Your Phone
ideas.angle: Exposes ultrasonic cross-device tracking where background TV audio sends inaudible 19kHz signals directly to your smartphone apps to sync your browsing profile. Challenges viewers to comment if they ever saw an ad right after watching TV and subscribe to lock down their device.

hook.en: Your TV is secretly tracking your phone.

ideas.reason: Solves the universal mystery of why users see ads immediately after watching cable TV without pushing fake microphone myths, backed by major FTC and IEEE cybersecurity studies.
sources: Federal Trade Commission Warning on Ultrasonic Tracking
IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy uXDT Research
Center for Democracy and Technology Cross-Device Report

ideas.title: The Battery Fingerprint That Tracks Incognito Mode
ideas.angle: Shows how the Battery Status API lets websites identify your device across incognito sessions by reading discharge rates down to 16 decimal places. Triggers an explosion of comments by telling viewers to comment their exact battery percentage right now to test their uniqueness.

hook.en: Check your exact battery percentage right now.

ideas.reason: Direct live challenge forces immediate interaction and comments while explaining a shocking Princeton cybersecurity loophole that breaks the illusion of private browsing.
sources: Princeton Web Transparency Project Battery Fingerprinting
Lukasz Olejnik Privacy Analysis of HTML5 Battery Status API
W3C Battery Status API Privacy Review

ideas.title: The Airplane Mode Location Trap
ideas.angle: Reveals that airplane mode only kills radio transmissions while satellite GPS chips and Bluetooth beacons keep recording your exact path offline to upload the instant you reconnect. Urges viewers to swipe down to inspect their active location toggles and share their findings in the comments.

hook.en: Turn this off before using airplane mode.

ideas.reason: Busts the most common digital survival misconception with a 3-second live phone check that creates an irresistible urge to verify settings on screen.
sources: FCC Guidelines on Passive Mobile Location Tracking
Apple iOS Airplane Mode Location Guidelines
Android Open Source Project GNSS Location Architecture
